title: Energy Prices Affect Toy Costs!
story: Energy prices are high, making it cost more to make toys. If prices stay high, toys like BLOK and RCCR might cost more too!
storyBig: The high energy prices are impacting manufacturing costs, potentially leading to increased prices for toys like BLOK and RCCR. If energy prices continue to rise, this could affect the entire toy industry.
